lines: 21:09:42  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Tanril): Nothing is taken from you. The door stays open, the key stays yours, and the record now says you walked out alive — that much is permanent. What happens now is your choice: stay and wander a world you have finished, or set it down here, at the best moment it has. Either is a real ending. I will not speak again unless you call.
